title: Act Apprentice (various trades under Apprentices Act, 1961)
qualification: 10th class (10+2 system) with minimum 50% aggregate marks and ITI in relevant trade from NCVT/SCVT recognised institute
age_limit: 15 to 24 years as on 11.04.2026 (upper age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen as per rules)
application_fee: ₹100 for UR/OBC/EWS males; No fee for SC/ST, female/Transgender and PwBD candidates
selection_process: Merit List Basis:Selection for SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 will be done purely on merit, by taking the average of percentage marks in 10th (minimum 50% aggregate) and ITI marks, giving equal weightage to both. || Tie-breaking:If two candidates have the same aggregate percentage, older candidate (higher age) will be preferred; if DOB is also same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier will be preferred. || Document Verification (DV):Shortlisted candidates will be called for DV where all original certificates (education, ITI, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, RDAT registration, medical fitness) will be verified. || Medical Fitness:Candidates must produce medical fitness certificate from a government-authorised doctor (Gazetted, not below Asst. Surgeon) in prescribed format at DV; without this, they will not be considered. || Training & Stipend:Selected candidates will undergo apprenticeship training as per Central Apprenticeship Council syllabus and receive stipend at prescribed rates during training. || No Job Guarantee:SCR apprenticeship 2025-26 provides training only; there isno guarantee of regular railway jobafter completion of apprenticeship.

title: Trained Graduate Teachers (TGT), Primary Teachers (PRT) and Balvatika Teachers (BVT)
qualification: All requisite essential and desirable qualifications as per detailed tables for TGT, PRT and Balvatika Teacher
total_posts: Not specified (vacancies that may arise during the academic year 2026-27 on contract basis)
salary: Balvatika Teacher (BVT) will be paid Rs. 27,625/- per month (Consolidated) with applicable TDS as per rule 17. || Primary Teacher (PRT) and Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) will be paid Rs. 34,125/- per month (Consolidated) with applicable TDS as per rule 17. || All posts are purely on contract basis for the academic year 2026-27 (from 01.04.2026 to 31.3.2027) and payment will be as per the notified consolidated pay.
age_limit: Balvatika Teacher (BVT): Maximum age 30 years as on 01-04-2026. || Primary Teacher (PRT): Maximum age 35 years as on 01-04-2026. || Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT): Maximum age 35 years as on 01-04-2026. || Age relaxation up to 5 years is applicable for SC/ST candidates. || Age relaxation up to 3 years is applicable for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates. || Age relaxation up to 10 years is applicable for Women candidates. || Age relaxation for Physically Challenged candidates is as per Government of India norms. || All the age relaxations will be concurrent; if a person is eligible for more than one concession, only one concession of the highest permissible limit will be granted.
application_fee: The advertisement does not mention any application fee. || It is stated that applications received after due date and time will be summarily rejected, but no fee payment process is described.
selection_process: Selection of the candidates for the teaching posts i.e., TGTs, PRTs and Balvatika Teachers will be prepared under Panel-I, Panel-II and Panel-III as per prescribed qualification combinations. || Only shortlisted candidates will be called for Skill Test and Practical classroom observation (Demo Teaching Class). || On the day of Skill Test and Demo Teaching Class, candidates must produce original documents of essential and desirable qualifications along with the application form uploaded against the link for verification of eligibility. || If the number of candidates registered for the Skill Test increases, the number of days for the Skill Test may be correspondingly extended and such information will be displayed on the notice board of AECS-2, Hyderabad, DAE Colony, D-Sector Gate, ECIL Post, Hyderabad – 500062. || Candidates must come prepared for Skill Test and Demo Teaching; they will be given a chance to present their own prepared topic as well as another topic randomly chosen by them from a box on the spot. || Marks scored in both years of Intermediate or 12th marks (for +2) will be taken for deciding the cut-off marks for shortlisting candidates for PRTs and Balvatika Teachers. || Marks scored in all three/four years of graduation including languages will be considered for deciding the cut-off marks for shortlisting candidates for TGT posts. || If the number of applications is more in any category/subject, eligibility criteria (cut off percentage) will be decided at the sole discretion of AEC Schools, Hyderabad and no communication will be entertained in this regard.
